en: Self-hosted runner: Added an orchestrator metric, `claude_code_self_hosted_orchestrator_sessions_given_up_total`, that counts by cause how often Anthropic gave up starting a runner for a session
zh: 自托管运行器：新增 orchestrator 指标 `claude_code_self_hosted_orchestrator_sessions_given_up_total`，按原因统计 Anthropic 放弃为 session 启动运行器的次数
